definition_zh: 风相对于平均分量的随机波动部分。
usage_note: 若原文讨论速度，使用 fluctuating wind velocity 对应“脉动风速”；不把 fluctuating wind 与 gust 自动互换。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道系统的随机动力分析中，风速随时间随机变化的成分用于计算抖振荷载，将风的随机波动作为系统激励纳入分析。

P011.title: A model for vehicle–track random interactions on effects of crosswinds and track irregularities
P011.label: Xu等（2019）

P111.title: 横风和轨道不平顺联合作用下的车辆-轨道系统随机分析模型
P111.label: 徐磊等（2018）

complete_examples.text: When the railway vehicle initially runs into the wind field, it will experience a severe vibration stage, and then stepping into a relatively steady state where the fluctuating winds and track irregularities will play deterministic roles in the deviations of system responses.

Based on the velocity spectrum of fluctuating wind of a moving vehicle, denoted by Suu(n), the following steps can be followed to simulate the fluctuating wind velocity ̃u(t): (1) Confirm the sampling number Nr at frequency domain n, where Nr is determined by the time scale of the fluctuating winds tu through the equation: Nr = tu/(1/nu), and Suu(n) is consequently interpolated into a new sequence with Nr discrete values.
The fluctuating winds are simulated using the modified spectral representation method with consideration of the spatial correlation of the fluctuating winds.

The Karhunen-Loève expansion method is applied to grasp the random features of fluctuating winds and the track random irregularities are generated by application of the track irregularity probabilistic model.
风速功率谱是描述脉动风速频域特性的最重要形式。
以脉动风和轨道随机不平顺为激扰源,且考虑轮轨动态相互作用、悬挂系统等非线性环节时,车辆-轨道系统可视为随机非线性动力系统。

suggested_comparisons.definition_zh: 文中作用于运行车辆的侧向风环境或风作用。
